BACKGROUND

A little background

The single carries a one-line dedication, “for the people I love”. Earlier that spring, youra’s EP B side came out with “Flicker”, which he arranged and sang on; its notes say he offered to join after hearing her demo in her studio.

  • Bugs — Tree: dedication and credits (Korean) ↗

INSIDE THE LYRICS

Finding room for awkwardness

  • Acceptance
  • Growing close

The beloved becomes a dancing tree, and the speaker becomes the rough music within it. The pairing gives awkwardness somewhere to belong. The speaker imagines even their timid fears becoming part of an affectionate picture when they are beside this person.

Asking for a smile suggests how much that acceptance matters. The lyric treats closeness as permission to bring an uncertain, unpolished self into a relationship. Its tenderness comes from the hope that someone can receive those parts with affection.

ABOUT THE ARTIST / 카더가든

Car, the garden

Car, the garden is a singer-songwriter whose music brings together rock, pop and R&B. His stage name is a playful translation of his Korean name, Cha Jung-won.

Before releasing music as Car, the garden, he was known as Mayson the Soul.
